step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. Ordinary-language entry, incomplete inputs, supported formats, extraction limitations, source coverage and existing-pitch reuse are explicit. The assistance ladder avoids making novice users invent research protocols. First-use usability remains unobserved.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Retain these requirements in onboarding and evaluate P2/P5 without author coaching. Unsupported extraction must produce an actionable request and an honest coverage limitation.

step_by_step_critique.step: C02 — Product and engineering questions and authority
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. Question acceptance is distinct from answer approval; uncertainty survives rejected wording; designated humans own decisions. Effort checkpoints, sufficient-answer rules and teammate handoffs make the interaction materially more concrete.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: During pilot preparation, identify case-specific decision authorities and effort envelopes. Check that disagreement remains visible and that settled questions are not repeated without changed evidence.

step_by_step_critique.step: C03 — AI, human and hybrid research
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. All three modes share claim-specific evidence standards. Research cards include assistance, bounded requests and return criteria. Private evidence may receive an attributable independent human assessment without being mislabeled AI-verified. Unsupported assertions cannot replace required observations.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Preserve separate statuses for observed evidence, expert judgment, human-reviewed private evidence and verification pending. P3 must demonstrate legitimate advancement without direct repository access.

step_by_step_critique.step: C04 — Solution-free framing and iterative Shape Up
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. Framing establishes the problem, outcome, appetite and boundaries without selecting a mechanism. Solution-specific uncertainty reopens research; scope changes reopen framing. Material feasibility requirements are distinguished from builder-level choices.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Keep proposed mechanisms from supplied documents explicitly unendorsed until shaping. Evaluate both premature solution selection and unnecessary demands for implementation proof.

step_by_step_critique.step: C05 — Multiple roles and independent contexts
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. Six scoped roles, work orders, candidate-only worker writes, reviewer independence conditions and isolation classifications are defined. Contamination now causes restart or review_pending. Host enforcement and shared-model limitations are honestly distinguished.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Select the first pilot host and document its actual inherited context, permissions and reviewer provenance before asserting enforcement. Do not introduce native agent packages through this role design.

step_by_step_critique.step: C06 — Artifacts, handoffs and resumable stages
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance with a recovery clarification. Logical artifact homes, stage inputs/transformations/exits, unique work orders, generations, dependency invalidation and replay behavior are specified. However, questions.json and decisions.json are separately mutable operational files, while the atomic acceptance description explicitly names only accepted-state version and acceptance records.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Before implementing persistence, specify whether question and decision snapshots are included in the atomic accepted revision or committed through an equivalent recovery mechanism. A crash must not expose an accepted stage with mismatched decisions or uncertainty state.

step_by_step_critique.step: C07 — Markdown, HTML, JSON and Google Docs
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. Markdown owns prose, JSON owns operational state and supports a meaningful document export, and HTML is derived. Google Docs reconciliation uses a published base, current target and current source. Both HTML AND Google Doc saved-target verification remain required for this task; reduced output scope cannot retroactively satisfy that obligation.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Bind delivery evidence to the same approved bundle and current destination revisions, including all tables, rendered diagrams and required style. Verify JSON fidelity separately. Content readiness may remain passed while required delivery remains blocked.

step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan-level gate acceptance, subject to the C06 transaction clarification. G0–G4 predicates and ReviewReceipt define mandatory assessments, evidence, subject bindings, provenance and explicit verdicts. Missing or unverifiable predicates hold advancement. Mechanical validity is not presented as truth or semantic adequacy.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Carry the declared predicates into versioned schemas and the transition specification. Include question/decision consistency in the transaction boundary, and preserve pass/fail/unverifiable distinctions. No validator behavior has been established by this review.

step_by_step_critique.step: C09 — Exemplar coverage, rendered artifacts and calibration
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance through the plan and its local source mapping. Required coverage retains component, sequence AND data-flow diagrams; rendered inspection; complete interface and security-owner coverage; inputs/outputs, material failures, trust boundaries, enforcement, persistence and non-responsibilities; and scope, safe cuts, mitigations and No-Gos. Rubric recalibration is explicitly pending and cannot waive G3.
step_by_step_critique.actionable_recommendation: Freeze the versioned rubric and explicit artifact checklist before trials. Preserve historical scores. Check cross-artifact meaning as well as inventories, and keep actual rendering and saved-target proof outstanding until observed.

Their verdicts and the author's repair claims were not treated as acceptance evidence.

step_by_step_critique.critique: Mostly meets plan acceptance. Canonical authoring, generated surfaces, private artifact placement, explicit native-agent admission and separation of installation/deployment are preserved. No Jira or product-code implementation is authorized. The future delivery outline omits explicit UAC plan/judge/apply, verified-main worktree setup, remote parity and task-owned cleanup, which the repository workflow requires.

This is a delivery-contract clarification, not permission to execute it now.

step_by_step_critique.step: C12 — Measurable pilot and deferred goal
step_by_step_critique.critique: Meets plan acceptance. P1–P10 distinguish successful progress from correct holds, include no-repo completion and recovery, and require case-specific effort expectations and independent evaluation. Goal creation is deferred and separated from human workshop decisions. Concrete cases, rubric calibration and host selection remain prerequisites rather than completed evidence.

After authorized implementation and appropriate verification, run uncoached sessions. Hold runtime-readiness and promotion claims until those results exist.
